description:
Planet Terry #4 (July 1985), Star Comics / Marvel. "In the Hand(s) of the Ruby Monster!" Written by Lennie Herman, art by Warren Kremer. 65 cent cover price.

Back cover: The Care Bears Movie ad.

Condition: reading copy. Piece missing/chewed area along the left edge of the back cover and a small chip at the right edge of the front cover; front cover otherwise bright (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
